comment: Suppresses known-good duplication from check-duplication.mjs. Two matcher forms: `fingerprint` (exact cluster — churns on edit, which deliberately resurfaces the cluster for re-triage) or `files` (every site of the cluster must live in the listed files — for permanent do-not-fix decisions that must survive edits). Optional `signal` narrows a files matcher.

entries.reason: Synthesis verdict: do not fix. The organizer daemon's model-offline backoff (BACKOFF_MIN/MAX ladder) and Breve's restart/lock retry are independently tuned policies for different failure domains; converging them would couple an in-app daemon to a launchd runtime.

Batch 0 independent_security_enforcement: the egress policy is deliberately implemented on both sides of the process boundary and held in parity by scripts/fixtures/egress-fixtures.json — shared literals (private ranges, redirect caps) are the fixture working as designed.
Batch 1 fixture-guarded mirror: endpoint_is_local (chat.rs) vs endpointIsLocal tests share the scripts/fixtures/parity.json endpoint fixture URLs by design.
Fixture-guarded mirror: secret.rs detector tests and loop.test.ts share the same red-team card/SSN vectors; check-secret-parity.mjs holds the two detectors aligned.

TS↔Rust process contract: the themed PDF renderer's argv (--in/--out/--title) is spelled by the script that parses it and by the Rust caller that spawns it; the shared literals are the contract, not copied logic (2026-09-02).
TS↔Rust IPC contract: the five Antigravity action words are spelled once by the command that dispatches them and once by the wrapper that sends them (2026-09-03).

The Antigravity setup card deliberately speaks the AI Models settings vocabulary (.ailane-* rows, .ghostbtn variants, chip states) so it reads as one surface; the shared literals are class names, not copied logic (2026-09-03).

MIRROR-NOT-IMPORT: the Rust search grammar tests and the TS twin's vectors share their literals ON PURPOSE (Groceries/sourdough/Launch checklist…) — the same inputs asserted on both sides of the app/shell boundary are the lockstep proof, not a copy to extract (docs/design/tantivy-search.md).

Both dialogs are instances of the one small modal grammar (.rename-overlay/.rename-card/.rename-btn, Cancel + primary action) from the design system; the shared literals are its class names and labels, not copied logic (2026-09-16).
The same Escape-closes-the-card keydown handler the shared dialog grammar prescribes (see web-connect-dialog-shares-rename-card).
